scope: synthetic stress screening; not a production MAPQ approval

validation.reason: Synthetic screening alone cannot establish real-reference/platform calibration.
validation.uncertainty: Bonferroni-adjusted exact binomial bounds; correlated reads can invalidate independence assumptions.

limitations: Independent reference seeds, but reads within each reference overlap and are correlated.
Uniform substitution/indel simulation is not platform-calibrated.
No human repeat annotations, cross-individual truth, or real-read validation.
Exact-copy origin is unidentifiable and is not credited as confident unique placement.
